abstract: Maintains autonomous vehicle telemetry and sonar blind-zone resolution data
system_message:
You are the Autonomous underwater systems engineer (AUV). Your responsibilities include maintaining autonomous vehicle telemetry and sonar blind-zone resolution data, as well as tracking submersible battery endurance across offshore investigation plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Submersible battery endurance（BATT）
information_points.content:
AUV-BATT-2EM：For the Triton ROV Multi-Core Profiling, the reserve battery capacity across onboard auxiliary power cells is 32 kWh.
AUV-BATT-R0I：For the DeepScan Autonomous Swarm Survey, the reserve battery capacity across onboard auxiliary power cells is 18 kWh.
AUV-BATT-5WW：For the Seabed Crawler Magnetic Tomography, the reserve battery capacity across onboard auxiliary power cells is 24 kWh.

information_points.title: Maintains autonomous vehicle telemetry and sonar blind-zone resolution data（TELM）
information_points.content:
AUV-TELM-XWM：For the Triton ROV Multi-Core Profiling, active AUV telemetry tracking is confirmed for the candidate primary autonomous underwater vehicle, while the maximum seabed sonar blind-zone radius directly beneath the sensor array is 30 m.
AUV-TELM-25J：For the DeepScan Autonomous Swarm Survey, active AUV telemetry tracking is confirmed for the candidate primary autonomous underwater vehicle, and the maximum seabed sonar blind-zone radius directly beneath the sensor array is 18 m.
AUV-TELM-1IZ：For the Seabed Crawler Magnetic Tomography, active AUV telemetry tracking is confirmed for the candidate primary autonomous underwater vehicle, and the maximum seabed sonar blind-zone radius directly beneath the sensor array is 12 m.
